description: Test suite for agent concurrency defaults, verifying resolution, validation, schema parsing, and config loading behaviors.

methods.name: resolveAgentMaxConcurrent
methods.description: Resolves the maximum number of concurrent agents, defaulting to DEFAULT_AGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT if unset or invalid.

methods.name: resolveSubagentMaxConcurrent
methods.description: Resolves the maximum number of concurrent subagents, defaulting to DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT if unset or invalid.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and returns the configuration object for the application, injecting defaults if necessary.

methods.name: withTempHome
methods.description: Sets up a temporary home environment, executes a callback, then cleans up.

methods.name: writeOpenClawConfig
methods.description: Writes a configuration object to the specified home directory.
